items.title: Babe Stovall Interview, 1974-04-16
items.q: Sylvia young blood used to live on Berkhandri Street.

ctx.x: You mean to pay for it? Right. To pay for it. Right. So you didn't ever make too much out in the country playing? No. They give you something. It's just not very much. Right. Oh yeah, because I did that the man who took grave, he said that he wasn't home, he couldn't tell you.
I don't know who was young blood, but you know Sylvia young blood? Sylvia young blood used to live on Berkhandri Street.
Tell me about the ones that you've ever seen.
